big_case.notes: Pro se All Writs Act application to preserve one co-owner's possession of a single house pending a Virginia mandamus/prohibition petition arising from a partition sale and a civil-contempt eviction sanction. Purely private stakes, no counsel, no amici, no public or doctrinal reach; denied in chambers in three days. Read formed from the now-OCR'd application text, which no candidate could read.
